article.name: AI Starter Plan
article.title: AI Starter Plan
article.body:
Best for 

The AI Starter plan is designed for individuals, small businesses, startups, and website owners who need one professional WordPress website with AI-powered website creation, managed hosting, speed optimization, and essential website management tools.

This plan is a good fit if you want to create and manage a single website with 10Web’s Agentic Website Builder, use 10Web Premium Hosting, and access the main tools needed to launch, edit, optimize, and maintain your site.

What’s included

The AI Starter plan includes the following functionalities and features along with their limitations:

1. High-performance WordPress hosting

  • Managed WordPress hosting: Fast and reliable 10Web Premium Hosting for 1 website.
  • 99.99% uptime: Websites hosted on 10Web are built for high availability and reliable performance.
  • Monthly visitors: The plan supports up to 10,000 visitors per month. For every 10K extra visitors, you’ll be charged an extra $2 at the end of the billing month. Visits are measured by the total monthly traffic, based on unique IPs, to your site.
  • SSD storage: Includes 10GB scalable storage with fees for overages if you exceed the limit. You’ll be charged an extra $2 at the end of the billing month for each extra 5GB used.
  • Free SSL certificate: 10Web provides you with a free one-click SSL using Let’s Encrypt integration.
  • Free custom domain: The AI Starter plan includes a free custom domain for 1 year, up to $30.
  • Bot and DDoS protection: Helps protect your websites from bot traffic and DDoS attacks.
  • Access to website files and database: Easy access to SSH, SFTP and MySQL.
  • Hosting usage analytics: Track key hosting usage data for your website from the 10Web dashboard.
  • Staging test environment: Test updates and changes in a staging environment before pushing them to your live website.
  • Automated 1-click migration: Move your website to 10Web from another hosting provider with automated migration tools.
  • Multisite support: Install WordPress multisite and manage all aspects of your WordPress multisite from the 10Web dashboard.

2. Agentic Website Builder

  • Agentic Website Builder: Create a production-ready WordPress website with AI agents that help generate the website structure, design, content, images, and key pages based on your business needs.
  • AI credits: The AI Starter plan includes 100 AI credits per month. These credits are used for AI-powered website generation and editing actions available in the platform.
  • Prompt-to-website generation: Start with a short description of your business, project, service, or online store, and generate a complete WordPress website that can be edited and launched.
  • Redesign agent: Transform an existing outdated page into a modern, improved version while keeping the website’s purpose and structure in mind.
  • Cloning agent: Recreate any page from a URL and turn it into an editable WordPress page.
  • Figma agent: Convert Figma designs into production-ready, responsive WordPress pages.
  • Advanced AI Editor: Make changes to layout, text, sections, images, and code by describing what you want in chat.
  • Mobile optimized: Generated websites are optimized for mobile devices, helping you provide a smooth experience across screen sizes.
  • Custom domain integration: Connect your custom domain to your 10Web-hosted website.
  • Full WordPress CMS: Websites generated with 10Web remain connected to WordPress, giving you the flexibility to manage content, pages, plugins, and site settings.

3. Ecommerce dashboard

  • Product and order management: Track and manage ecommerce products and orders through the 10Web interface.
  • 10Web Payments: Accept payments with 10Web Payments.
  • Ecommerce analytics: Track important store data and better understand how your online store is performing.
  • Conversion-optimized checkout: Use checkout tools designed to help customers complete purchases smoothly.
  • Automated tax setup: Configure tax settings more easily for your ecommerce website.
  • Advanced product filter: Help customers find products faster with product filtering tools.
  • Customer accounts: Allow customers to create and use accounts on your ecommerce website.

4. Website speed optimization

  • Full website optimization: Automatically optimizes both the front end and back end of your website.
  • 90+ PageSpeed score: Helps achieve a 90+ PageSpeed score for desktop and mobile through a series of technical optimizations.
  • Improved Core Web Vitals: Helps ensure your website meets Core Web Vitals standards.
  • SEO optimized website: Generated and hosted websites include SEO-focused foundations to support better search visibility.
  • Image optimization: Applies various techniques to optimize images, reducing file sizes and improving loading times without compromising quality.
  • Full page caching: Improves website performance by caching pages and reducing load times for visitors.
  • Dynamic page caching for Ecommerce: Improves store performance with caching designed for dynamic ecommerce pages.

5. 24/7 customer support

  • Email assistance: Submit tickets with any issues you have and our team will get back to you in the shortest time.
  • 24/7 chat support: Our customer support team is at your service 24/7. Reach out to us anytime.

6. Collaboration and automated website maintenance

  • User & team management: Invite users and give them different permissions to your account and websites.
  • Automated WordPress and plugin updates: Schedule automated updates for WordPress plugins and themes through the 10Web dashboard.
  • Automated daily backups: Scheduled automatic daily backups enable you to restore a previous version of your site whenever needed.
  • Activity log: Track important changes and actions across your website for easier website management.
  • Up-to-date PHP and MySQL: Keep your website running on supported technologies for better performance, compatibility, and security.

What's not included

The AI Starter plan doesn’t include certain advanced services and functionalities. Below are the features not included in this plan:

  • Cloudflare CDN: Access to Cloudflare Enterprise CDN requires an additional purchase. To purchase CDN, go to the 10Web dashboard, click the Manage button on the website thumbnail for which you want to enable CDN, then navigate to the Website Booster tab > Cloudflare CDN, and click the Buy Now button.
  • White Label for WordPress: Available only with Agency plans.
  • VIP priority support: Available only with Agency plans.

Price and billing cycle

For pricing details about the AI Starter plan, please visit this page. You have the option to choose between monthly, annual, and longer-term billing cycles when available.

If you already have the AI Starter plan and wish to change your billing cycle:

  • Go to the Subscription Plan page.
  • If you’re currently on a monthly plan and want to switch to an annual plan, click Switch to Annual to make the change.

Note:

Longer billing cycles may be more cost-effective than monthly billing. Please check the pricing page or your checkout screen for the current billing options and savings.

Upgrade options

Adding more websites

If you need additional websites, you can add them to your AI Starter plan from the Subscription Plan page. Additional website pricing may vary based on the selected billing cycle, so the current amount is shown during checkout.

  1. Log into your 10Web dashboard.
  2. Go to the Subscription Plan page.
  3. Click Buy Additional Website.
  4. Specify the number of websites.
  5. Complete the checkout.

Upgrading to a higher plan

Consider a higher plan if you require more websites, more AI credits, more monthly visitors, more storage, or additional features.

  1. Log into your 10Web dashboard.
  2. Go to the Subscription Plan page.
  3. Click the Upgrade button.
  4. Choose a plan and billing cycle.
  5. Complete the checkout.

Upgrade limitations

Note that there may be some limitations when upgrading your plan directly from your dashboard. You will have limitations if:

  • Your current plan, including add-ons such as additional websites and CDN, has a higher monthly or annual price than the plan you want to upgrade to.
  • Your current plan’s storage and visitor limits, including add-ons, are higher than the plan you want to upgrade to.

For assistance in these cases, contact our customer support team via live chat.

Downgrading to a lower plan

If you wish to downgrade your plan, for instance, from annual to monthly billing or to a lower-tier subscription, please contact our Customer Care team. Downgrading is a manual process handled by our Billing Team, as it cannot be performed directly through your account. Our support agents will assist you in making the necessary adjustments to your subscription.
